facebook.content:
The Kingdom doesn’t hand us “more”—it calls us to “enough.” When we chase extra income, we’re running from the promise of Psalm 23:1, “The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.” Your need is already met in Him; the pursuit of surplus blinds you to the provision already flowing.  

What one area of your finances will you surrender today so you can live on the “enough” God provides?

What kingdom authority will you claim today that changes how you live?
